purpose: Teach: 符号/執拗/再三/先々/最長/怠慢/随所/つくろ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内通信の符号化規則を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the internal communication protocols.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Slight lean forward—this matters. Measured pace. Authoritative but collaborative, not commanding. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。執拗な営業電話には毅然と対応します
lines.en: Yes. We'll handle persistent sales calls with firmness.
lines.style: Agreement with quiet conviction. Short pause after the dash. Respectful, not obsequious. Steady tone—reliable. Nods slightly on 'firmness'.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 再三の打ち合わせで方針を固めましょう
lines.en: Let's solidify our approach through repeated check-ins.
lines.style: Deliberate, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'solidify'—cementing the idea. Even pace. Forward-leaning, invested. No rush, but no drift either.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先々の人員計画を立てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll draft our staffing strategy ahead of time.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Matter-of-fact, no inflation. Calm certainty. Slightly faster than the previous line—efficient, moving forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 最長納期のクライアントを優先しましょう
lines.en: Let's prioritise the clients with the longest deadlines.
lines.style: Clear direction, not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'longest'—that's the logic. Calm authority. Pace steady and unhurried. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。怠慢な対応は社員研修で改善します
lines.en: Yes. We'll address lapses in care through staff development.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Deliberate word choice—'lapses' not 'failures.' Professional, not punitive in tone. Steady, committed. Slight finality.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 随所にお客様視点を取り入れましょう
lines.en: Let's weave the customer perspective throughout everything we do.
lines.style: Emphatic but measured. Slight weight on 'weave'—it's embedded, not an afterthought. Warm beneath the professionalism. Pace relaxes slightly—a principle, not a task.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い手順をつくろうマニュアルに刷新します
lines.en: Yes. I'll update our procedures and modernise the manual accordingly.
lines.style: Solid closing agreement. Calm, assured. Two clear commitments—each gets its moment. Final line of a plan: grounded, complete. Slight settling on the final word.
